rates.city: player budget plus per-city budget per turn (proposed: 16)
rates.none: not applicable (command is never accepted from a client)
rates.player: session budget per frame and per turn (proposed V1 default: 64 / 4096)
rates.turn: turn control: a few per turn (proposed: 8)
rates.unit: player budget plus per-unit budget per turn (proposed: 16)

steps: 1. range: frame size, known name, argument types, ranges, strings (UTF-8, no control characters, length)
3. player: acting player from the session; player/team arguments in range and alive
4. ownership: unit/city belongs to the session player
5. phase: turn active, not paused / loading / resyncing; pending: the decision really is pending for the session player
6. applicability: the DLL can* function; every dll_gaps entry has an explicit rule
7. rate: rate limit class of the command
